integrity: The primary full text was inspected at the model definition, raw-moment derivation, Table 2, and MGF section. The counterexample is fully analytic and lies inside the stated parameter space. The numerical checker independently compares direct quadrature, the printed series, and the corrected beta-one formula.
scientific_limitations: The general corrected moment is left as an exact one-dimensional integral; a closed hypergeometric form is proved only for beta equal to one.
The finding does not claim that Table 2 was computed from the invalid displayed formula; one row agrees with the corrected value.
No identifiability, estimation, simulation-consistency, or application result is reassessed.
title: UWG moment formula is invalid; the beta-one slice has an exact correction
